desc:
Battle it out with rivals across floating islands in this hardcore PvP parkour game! Leap across treacherous gaps, grind loot spawners (click the signs for XP and gear), and crack open crates for epic rewards. Juke your opponents, enchant your weapons and armor with the XP you earn, and climb your way up the leaderboard.

How to Play:

Parkour: Leap island to island
Loot Spawners: Click signs to grab items
Crates: Activate, hold your ground, then snag the rare loot
Enchant: Spend XP to upgrade your gear
Fight & Rank Up: Take out other players and claim the islands!

Tags: SkyFight, Fighting, Farming, Forge, Enchant, Items, PvP, SkyPvP, IslandPvP, Mace
